messages:
elaine: saw a steady ~2.7% invoice-preview vs ledger drift starting ~02:40 UTC after we enabled quota_smoothing=v2. Preview shows tokens smoothed into earlier buckets, ledger uses strict event-time windows. anyone else see this? :confused:

ben: yeah noticed it on the daily billing diff graph. smoothing moves small bursts into prior windows which improves latency but changes per-window totals.

karim: quick root guess: preview runs smoothing at emit-time (client-side), ledger re-aggregates by event_time on ingest. mismatch between emit-time vs event-time semantics will show as drift.

elaine: mitigation proposals: A) revert smoothing until we can align semantics, B) harmonize by stamping `smoothing_bucket_id` on every meter event so ledger can apply the same bucketing, or C) switch ledger to consume emit-time bucketing (risky). I vote B.

ben: +1 for B. cheap and backwards-compatible: add `smoothing_bucket_id = floor(emit_ts / 60s)` or hashed window id. Then preview and ledger can join on that id to reconcile.

karim: will implement shim: attach `smoothing_bucket_id` and a flag `smoothing_version="v2"` behind FF and 0.5% canary. Also add metric `billing.smoothing.drift_ratio`. Alert if preview/ledger ratio not in [0.995,1.02] for 30m.

elaine: SQL for dashboard card (warehouse):
```sql
SELECT smoothing_bucket_id, SUM(tokens) FILTER (WHERE plane='preview') as preview_tokens, SUM(tokens) FILTER (WHERE plane='ledger') as ledger_tokens
FROM metering.events_with_bucket
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '6 hours'
GROUP BY smoothing_bucket_id
ORDER BY smoothing_bucket_id DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

deploy-bot: staging deploy queued for feature/smoothing-bucket-shim  build 4782 (staging).

ops-bot: alert rule created: billing.smoothing.drift_ratio > 1.02 for 30m -> page oncall-billing.

ben: after canary if ratios look good schedule a 24h backfill that computes smoothing_bucket_id for recent events so invoice auditors can reconcile. coordinate with invoice-audit first.

elaine: agreed. i'll update the runbook entry "smoothing-induced preview/ledger drift" with triage steps and links to the new dashboard. will post canary results here. :thumbsup:
